J12 — Conn_01x02 (illustrated: power_screw_terminal_round)
XT30 power connector (2-pole)
svg.desc: Amass XT30 yellow 2-pole power connector (XT30-M), one of the three XT30s in the VFET / IN / BED OUT power row along the bottom edge of the Smoothieboard v2 Prime. Flat top-down illustration: the moulded yellow housing with its two keying chamfers at the far end and the two round gold-plated bullet contacts in their dark wells on a 5 mm pitch.

svg.text: Cable: GF/J37 pins 1–10 → J1 pins 1–10, including both unused supply rails. Verify cable continuity.
Two solid internal paths represent equal source nets, not literal PCB trace placement or extra field wires.
J3 pins 1,2,4–9; J2 chain; J4 Qwiic; TP1/TP2 unused. Leave links intact.
Gray dashed leaders locate actual source artwork. Contact banks are schematic electrical identities.
J37 host is unshrouded: source-backed contact numbers do not qualify cable mating-face orientation.
Existing source art includes synthesized connector drawings; geometry is retained without mating claims.
P11 host artwork; pinned P12 comparison confirms GF/J37 pad geometry and electrical assignment.
